authority.user_instruction: Continue from the latest verified checkpoint, implement one bounded measurable improvement at a time, bind workflow authority to an operator-approved manifest digest outside the repository, and expose a stable machine-readable CLI before any reusable Codex skill.

scope.objective: Freeze and implement IncidentSeal's versioned manifest authority and machine-readable host CLI contract with deterministic, fail-closed behavior before introducing the Compose runtime.
forbidden_work: Allowing repository content or an agent-facing command to create or replace operator approval
Pulling, running, or redistributing a candidate image outside its approved gate
Adding a third-party dependency before a separate source gate
Starting the Compose, PostgreSQL, runner, dashboard, or release implementation before the CLI and manifest contracts pass
Claiming an unverified real product surface
reversible_actions: Create and edit repository contracts, schemas, fixtures, source, tests, and documentation
Create an isolated test approval store outside the repository under the project test harness
Run dependency-free local validation and mutation tests
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: A proposed change alters the approved product promise or trust boundary
The external approval boundary cannot fail closed
A dependency is required without a ready source gate
A stable machine contract requires an unresolved product choice
A checkpoint cannot be verified locally and after push

units.purpose: Freeze the versioned manifest schema, canonicalization rules, digest approval boundary, stable CLI commands, exit codes, JSON schemas, and mutation vectors as dependency-free machine contracts.
inputs: Current Codex AGENTS.md and non-interactive JSON guidance

exit_condition_delta.rationale: This is the smallest contract-first unit that prevents implementation from defining authority or evidence semantics by accident.

units.purpose: Implement dependency-free manifest parsing, schema checks, canonicalization, SHA-256 digesting, and stable CLI envelopes.
Implement and probe the operator-owned approval store outside repository custody, with inspect and compare available to agents but approval replacement unavailable through agent-facing paths.
Run deterministic golden-vector, malformed-input, policy-drift, stale-approval, ambiguous-approval, and repository-tampering mutation evaluations.
Validate the packaged local CLI contract from a clean temporary copy without Docker runtime use.
Commit, push, and live-verify the bounded IS-0002 checkpoint without making a software-release claim.
